tasks.label: Agent Orchestrator (manual)
tasks.detail: Normally auto-spawned by extension. Use only for debugging.

tasks.label: Clean Sandbox Fresh
tasks.command: if (Test-Path '.sandbox-fresh') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force '.sandbox-fresh' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.sandbox-fresh' | Out-Null; Write-Host '✓ .sandbox-fresh wiped clean'
tasks.detail: Compiles extension, then wipes .sandbox-fresh/ for a clean-slate test.

tasks.label: MCP-Only: Open VS Code (Copilot + MCP)
tasks.detail: Opens a dedicated 'MCP-Only' profile with the Project Brain extension disabled. Copilot Chat sees the brain ONLY via the MCP server (sample-project/.vscode/mcp.json). One-time: disable all extensions except GitHub Copilot + Copilot Chat in that profile.
